name: flightradar-monorepo
description: Flight tracking map built on MeowTileKit

scripts.dist:dir: npm run setup:data && npm run build -w @flightradar/web && npm run dist:dir -w @flightradar/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run setup:data && npm run build -w @flightradar/web && npm run dist:win -w @flightradar/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @flightradar/shared && npm run typecheck -w @flightradar/server && npm run typecheck -w @flightradar/web && npm run typecheck -w @flightradar/desktop
